title: Joseph Forgives His Brothers
summary: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 45:1-15 and look for how this passage teaches: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.

tell_it: Joseph could have punished his brothers, but he forgave them. He saw that God had used hard things to save many lives.
understand_it: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Joseph Forgives His Brothers reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. God teaches mercy.
age_8_11_explanation: Joseph Forgives His Brothers shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.
teen_explanation: Joseph Forgives His Brothers gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when forgiveness is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Joseph choose instead of revenge?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Forgiveness. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 45:5 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Joseph Forgives His Brothers?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Forgiveness Bridge
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Joseph Forgives His Brothers. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
